title: Gathin23/cleanyourtv
body:
Debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home.

README 節錄： **The viral tweet:** x.com/gathint/status/2111379569030939102 On 17 October 2026 I posted a before and after of my parents' TV, cleaned up by Claude Code over Wi-Fi. It reached 7.4M views, people started doing the same to their own TVs, and their replies turned into the lists here: 170+ TV models from 200+ contributors in four days. The repo was called tv-vibehack until the 19th; old links work. ## How it works Android TVs have the same debug bridge as Android phones. Switch on USB debugging in the TV's developer options, allow your computer once, and the rest is standard Android tooling: | Step | What happens | |---|---| | **Back up** | The list of installed packages and settings. | | **Disable** | The manufacturer's telemetry, ad services, content rows and preloaded junk, with `pm disable-user`. Nothing is uninstalled, so a restore script can undo every step. | | **Install** | A small native launcher, made the default home screen. | **No root, no cable, nothing uninstalled, and a one-line restore if you change your mind.** The bloat differs by brand, so the prompt has your coding assistant discover it on your TV and ask before touching anything you might use. ## Quick start You need a computer on the same Wi-Fi as the TV and a coding assistant with shell access. Any of these work: Claude Code (on 0G Private Computer or an Anthropic plan), Codex or Gemini CLI. | Where | What to do |

title: finereli/whatsapp-mcp
body:
A read-only MCP server that lets your AI agent search and read your own WhatsApp messages. Runs on Cloudflare Workers.

README 節錄：# whatsapp-mcp Let your AI agent read your WhatsApp messages. This is a small server that runs in your own Cloudflare account. You link your phone to it once, the way you'd link WhatsApp Web, and from then on any MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, anything that speaks MCP) can search and read your chats. It can read and search your messages, and remember names you give it for phone numbers. It can't send anything. Ask your agent things like: - "What did Dana say about the flights?" - "Find every message where someone mentioned the lease, across all my chats." - "Summarize what I missed in the family group this week." ## How it works Your phone stays the source of truth. The server is a linked device that your agent talks to. It doesn't stay connected to WhatsApp. When your agent asks for something, and once a day, it connects, collects whatever WhatsApp queued for it since last time, writes that to its own database, and hangs up. Your phone keeps working normally and keeps getting notifications. Your messages live in a SQLite database inside a Durable Object in your Cloudflare account. Nothing goes anywhere else. ## Set it up You need a Cloudflare account on the Workers Paid plan (see the note below), Node 20 or later, and your phone. ```sh git clone https://github.com/finereli/whatsapp-mcp cd whatsapp-mcp npm install # 1. An open-source stack for generalist computer-use agents, combining code execution, GUI interaction, and cross-device control.

README 節錄： ### GPT-6 made computer use the frontier. We make it open. News · Results · Demos · **Quick start** · SDK · Open stack · How it works · Contributing · Contact **Computer use has reached a turning point.** GPT-6 Astra's demos offered an exciting vision of what computer-use agents could make possible, and the focus is expanding from GUI-only interaction to both visual and programmatic interfaces. The question has changed, from how well a model operates a GUI to how well a system completes work on a real computer by whatever means works. **We call such a system a generalist computer-use agent (GCUA).** It uses a computer in more ways than you do. It reads the accessibility tree and calls app APIs, runs shell commands, and operates the GUI when it needs to. With **code execution**, it writes GUI operations as code and combines them with all of these in one program, with loops and conditions. It can also share the computer with you, working in background windows without interrupting what you are doing. **Yet frontier systems remain largely closed.** We therefore introduce **Open Generalist CUA (OpenGCUA)**, an ongoing project to develop and open the full stack for GCUAs with the community, including model, system, trajectories, efficiency optimization, and evaluation. **What we open in this version:** - 🧠 **OSWorld integration example** with re

CVE Intel does that legwork for you. Give it a vulnerability ID, your project's dependency list, or a suspicious IP address, file hash or domain. README 節錄：# dsh-sd-bridge-guard **DeepSeek Harness 插件 · 本机 Stable Diffusion 生图九件套 + 违规分流协议（A 档 / C 档）· 跨机器零适配** 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接调用你电脑里的 Stable Diffusion WebUI 生图：不用提前打开 SD（首次调用自动以纯 API 模式拉起）、不用改任何路径——装上插件就能用。 --- ## 🆕 版本更新内容（v1.0.1 · 2026-10-16） **本轮三件事：下载后能自查缺什么、蒙版可以鼠标手绘、C 档违禁词能注入表单。** ### ① 文件完整性检测（新功能） 别人拿到插件后不再只能靠「跑一下看看报不报错」判断包是否完整——现在有**基线清单 + 反向比对**： ```bash node verify-integrity.mjs # 本机 vs 随包清单，终端彩色表格 node verify-integrity.mjs --remote # 再比对仓库最新版（列出新增/更新/移除） node verify-integrity.mjs --md # Markdown 表格（贴 issue / 回复用） node verify-integrity.mjs --json # 机器可读 ``` 或在 DSH 里直接说「**检查一下 SD 插件少了什么文件**」→ 模型调 `sd_integrity` 工具，回你一张排好版的表： | 状态 | 文件 | 分类 | 大小 | 影响 | |------|------|------|------|------| | ✗ 必需 | `sd-mask-qa.py` | runtime | 6737B | 插件无法运行 | | △ 辅助 | `test-vram-release.ps1` | tool | 3441B | 该功能不可用 | | · 可选 | `CHANGELOG.md` | doc | 123626B | 不影响运行 | 分类决定严重度（`runtime` / `tool` / `doc`·`dev`·`ci`），不搞一刀切——npm 包装不上 dev/doc 是正常的，只有 `runtime` 缺失才是真告警。 **自动触发点**：插件启动时跑一次（缺必需文件记醒目告警）；退出时再跑一次并落盘 `~/.dsh-sd-bridge/integrity-report.{json,md}`。 **发布者侧**：`node gen-manifest.mjs` 生成基线，`--check` 校验是否过期（CI 用）；`prepublishOnly` 已挂自动生成 + 校验。 ### ② 手绘蒙版（新功能） C 档参数表「蒙版」下拉新增 **`手动绘制（鼠标涂抹）`**（紧跟「自动」之后）——选中即弹出参考图，鼠标涂出要重绘的区域： | 操作 | 效果 | |------|------| | 左键拖动 | 涂抹要重绘的区域（笔迹显示为半透明红） | | 右键拖动 | 擦除 | | 滚轮 | 调笔刷大小（6–200 px，标题栏实时显示） | | `C` 键 / 清空 | 清空全部笔迹 | | `Enter` / 确定 | 保存蒙版并出图 | | `Esc` / 取消 | 放弃，**回退自动蒙版**（不静默重画整张） | 画布最长边压到 900 px

title: openbin-ai/binny
body:
BINNY: an open source agent harness for reverse engineering. Plug in any model, or a local one.

README 節錄： BINNY An open source agent harness for reverse engineering. Plug in any model, point it at a binary, and it works through the code with real tools and hands you a report to review. BINNY is the harness, not the model. It brings the tools (decompiled functions, strings, imports, data, a sealed sandbox, local Ghidra), the playbooks, the triage, investigate, draft loop, the budgets, the checkpoints and the report format. The model is whatever you plug in: Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Gemini, Bedrock, or a local model through Ollama or LM Studio. BINNY opens one of your OpenBin or OpenAPK projects, or decompiles a file on your disk, and runs that loop against the decompiled code. Every step is a tool call you can watch: it lists functions, reads decompilations, pulls strings, imports and data, runs scripts in a sealed sandbox, and records findings as it goes. The draft lands on the project report for you to check before anything is published. It runs on your own model key, or on a local model. Nothing about your sample goes to us unless you put it in a project. ## Install macOS and Linux: ```sh curl -fsSL https://openbin.ai/install-binny.sh | sh ``` Windows (PowerShell): ```powershell irm https://openbin.ai/install-binny.ps1 | iex ``` Then: ```sh openbin login # once; BINNY reuses the openbin CLI's sign-in binny # pick a project, set a key, go ``` Prebuilt binaries fo

The numbers this release measured with EAGLE-4 are in the support matrix . ## EAGLE-4 **Leave speculation on. EAGLE-4 adapts to your hardware, batch and workload.** EAGLE-4 (Extrapolation Algorithm for Greater Language-model Efficiency) speeds up LLM inference with speculative decoding. EAGLE-4 draft models are built to run with `eagle-harness`, which decides how far to speculate from measured costs on your setup, so every draft tree fits the batch size, the hardware and the workload. The output stays exactly what the target model would generate on its own: up to 3.4× faster generation on Qwen3.8-27B, with the same answers. Measured speedups This repository holds `eagle-harness`, the package that brings EAGLE-4 to SGLang, vLLM and TokenSpeed. Install it, point your engine at an EAGLE-4 draft model, and it serves with EAGLE-4. ## Quick start The quick start serves on one GPU and is tested on one NVIDIA B300 with Linux and a CUDA 13 driver. Qwen3.8-27B and its EAGLE-4 draft download on the first start (about 62 GB). The measured speedups use four B300 GPUs.
